arrivals.fileexport.says: Taking in every document of the record: converting each, working out its records and writing them to the pod.

arrivals.convert.says: Converting the source record into the pod's own format with the adapter.

arrivals.accepting.says: Finding which adapter accepts this document.

arrivals.parsegraph.says: Reading the converted records as facts.

arrivals.refuseunaccounted.says: Checking that nothing in the converted records was left unexplained.

arrivals.arrivals.says: Working out what each arriving record is and where it belongs.

arrivals.revisions.says: Working out which records are new versions of ones the pod already holds.

arrivals.revisions.prepare.says: Getting the existing records ready to compare with the arriving ones.

arrivals.revisions.write.says: Writing the new versions of records.

arrivals.revisionsof.says: Finding the earlier versions of one record.
